Subject: Your breach of contract matter (Project Eagle)

Dear Mr. Fernandes,

Thank you for meeting us on 3 March 2023 about your dispute with M/s Aravali Infotech Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the claim must be filed as a commercial suit.

Our advice is to complete pre-institution mediation before filing the commercial suit. Please collect the mediation request and the statement of accounts and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
